verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Gitea supports over 20 public or private package types from the same platform, including Cargo, Composer, Conan, Conda, Container, Helm, Maven, npm, NuGet, PyPI and RubyGems. That directly covers multi-format package hosting. The evidence is a single summary claim with no detail on how publishing or consuming works. Missing for 10: documented publish/consume workflows (client configuration, authentication, registry URLs), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the package registry works in practice.
